note: City of Storm Lake campground on the east shore of Storm Lake, across Sunrise Park Road and the lakeside recreation trail from the water; boat ramp and dock across the road, fish cleaning station, walking distance to King's Pointe Waterpark, Sunrise Pointe Golf Course and the Regatta Grille. Attendants on site about mid-April to mid-September. --Claude
summary: Fees $20-30 confirmed (city rate page). Added showers, flush toilets, dump, booking platform (Rec1), 2-night weekend / 3-night holiday minimums; hookups water/sewer, 103 sites, pull-through, wifi and laundry confirmed; note-derived 73-ft max rig cleared (no official length). Lakeview kept: Sunrise Park Road and the recreation trail separate every site from the lake. Pin in the lake, moved. Note cleaned.
flags: WATERFRONT (lakeview kept): the city's facility map shows Sunrise Park Road and then the paved Recreation Trail between every row and Storm Lake (~3,200 acres), with a shelter, volleyball court, boat dock and boat ramp (day use) on the lake side; on imagery the nearest pads (rows 101-105, 701-739 and 801-804, the rows along the road) are ~60-100 m from the shore across mowed lawn and scattered trees. No on-water site. Camper reports confirm views across the road (8/2026 site 703: 'The view from my standard site was of the lake across the road'; site 101 'a view of the lake'). The coastal-dunes rule doesn't apply (mowed shore).
ELECTRIC: the city's pages give no amperage; stored 50-amp (note-derived) left as is, unconfirmed.
SEASON: the city says only 'staffed with onsite attendants from approximately mid-April to mid-September'; no open/close dates for the campground, so no season written.
LONG-TERM ROW: the map marks sites 501-509 as 'Long-term camp sites' (9 of 103); the rest are nightly - not a long-stay concern.
PIN: stored 42.62650,-95.17650 is in Storm Lake, ~200 m west of the shore. Sites' centre on imagery ~42.6280,-95.1747 (the angled rows east of Sunrise Park Road); correct it.

WEBSITE: stored city page is right; sunrisecampgrounds.com (printed on the map) now forwards to the city's Rec1 booking catalog https://secure.rec1.com/IA/storm-lake-ia/catalog. Phone 712-732-8023 matches the city page.
